fail_closed_verification.release_gate: rejects missing/tampered/malformed manifest, SBOM and provenance; production signature verification blocks without approved identity policy
fail_closed_verification.recovery_gate: rejects non-identical outputs, unsafe rollback evidence and pre-authorized rollback records

offline_semantics.internet_outage: local runtime may continue in reduced mode; cloud synchronization resumes after connectivity returns
offline_semantics.laptop_powered_off: local collectors halt; remote cloud continuity is a separate target and must not be conflated with an internet outage

recovery_lessons: configured push triggers are not proof of an exact-SHA successful run
exact-head PR CI and exact-main release evidence are distinct claims
Drive presence alone is not recovery proof
schema or registry evolution must update fail-closed validators and tests in lockstep
stale or conflicted continuity PRs should be replayed from exact current main rather than merged blindly
implementation-to-registry coupling remains non-authoritative until bypass coverage and rollback/recovery replay are proven
bounded gap repair must rotate across deferred windows and exhaustive repair must continue while deferred gaps remain
laptop power-off and internet outage are distinct failure modes
credential- or billing-dependent provider smoke tests require explicit owner authority and cannot be inferred from ordinary CI success
